\section*{Master's Thesis (in progress)}
\textbf{Image Retrieval with DINO Features and SVD} (working title)\par
Supervisor: Vahan Huroyan $\vert$ Expected completion: Spring 2027
\begin{itemize}
\item Conducted experiments with frozen DINO features, comparing whole-image, matrix, and SVD-based subspace representations for retrieval on Revisited Oxford using mean average precision; evaluated one fixed candidate on Revisited Paris and visualized rankings in an interactive demo.
\item Next phase: reproduce the supervised Grassmann pooling framework of Wei et al. (ECCV 2018), including learned dimensionality reduction, SVD-based pooling, and a learned classifier based on projection similarity.
\end{itemize}
